description: This file defines the IPowerManager interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including enums, structs, and methods related to power management, thermal states, wakeup sources, and notifications.

classes.name: IPowerManager
classes.description: Interface for managing power states, thermal states, wakeup sources, and related notifications in a device.

methods.name: AddPowerModePreChangeClient
methods.description: Register a client to participate in power mode pre-change operations.

methods.name: RemovePowerModePreChangeClient
methods.description: Remove a client from participating in power mode pre-change operations.

methods.name: GetPowerState
methods.description: Retrieve the current and previous power states.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Set high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: GetLastWakeupReason
methods.description: Get the reason for last wakeup.

methods.name: GetLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Get the key code that caused last wakeup.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboot the device with specified reasons.

methods.name: GetPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Get power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: PowerModePreChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicate completion of pre-change activities for a client.

methods.name: DelayPowerModeChangeBy
methods.description: Delay power mode change for a client.
